description: Source code for the ICM42688 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including sensor data conversion, reading, configuration, and initialization functions.

methods.name: icm42688_convert_accel
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42688_convert_gyro
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42688_convert_temp
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42688_channel_parse_readings
methods.description: Parses sensor readings based on channel type.

methods.name: icm42688_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for a specific channel.

methods.name: icm42688_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample from the sensor.

methods.name: icm42688_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency and full scale.
